---
title: "Australian Wine Sales — Static Forecasting Mockup"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(fpp3)

wine_wide <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/AustralianWines.csv",
  na = "*",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

names(wine_wide) <- trimws(names(wine_wide))

wines <- wine_wide |>
  mutate(
    Month = yearmonth(
      as.Date(paste0("01-", Month), format = "%d-%b-%y")
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -Month,
    names_to = "Varietal",
    values_to = "Sales"
  ) |>
  arrange(Varietal, Month) |>
  group_by(Varietal) |>
  mutate(
    Sales = if (anyNA(Sales)) {
      approx(
        which(!is.na(Sales)),
        Sales[!is.na(Sales)],
        xout = seq_along(Sales),
        rule = 2
      )$y
    } else Sales
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month, key = Varietal)
```

## Data visualization

```{r}
selected <- wines |>
  filter(Varietal %in% c("sparkling", "Dry white"))

selected |>
  autoplot(Sales) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Varietal), scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Australian wine sales",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Sales"
  )
```

## Train / validation split

```{r}
train_end <- yearmonth("1992 Dec")

training <- selected |>
  filter(Month <= train_end)

validation <- selected |>
  filter(Month > train_end)
```

## Fit TSLM, ETS, and ARIMA

```{r}
fit <- training |>
  model(
    TSLM = TSLM(Sales ~ trend() + season()),
    ETS = ETS(Sales),
    ARIMA = ARIMA(Sales)
  )

fit
```

## Training accuracy

```{r}
accuracy(fit) |>
  select(Varietal, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)
```

## Validation accuracy

```{r}
validation_fc <- fit |>
  forecast(
    new_data = validation |>
      select(Varietal, Month)
  )

accuracy(validation_fc, validation) |>
  select(Varietal, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE)
```

## Validation forecast comparison

```{r}
validation_fc |>
  autoplot(selected, level = c(80, 95)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Varietal), scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Validation forecasts",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Sales"
  )
```

## Future forecast

```{r}
final_fit <- selected |>
  model(
    TSLM = TSLM(Sales ~ trend() + season()),
    ETS = ETS(Sales),
    ARIMA = ARIMA(Sales)
  )

future_fc <- final_fit |>
  forecast(h = 12)

future_fc |>
  autoplot(selected, level = c(80, 95)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Varietal), scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "12-month future forecast",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Sales"
  )
```
